blocks.html: Robinsons Malls continues its yearly tradition of spreading the Season’s spirit of hope and happiness as it unveils its beautiful and resplendent Christmas decors in all its malls nationwide. Majestic trees rise at the mall atriums, bountifully decked with glittering ornaments and luminous LED lights.

At Robinsons Galleria, mallgoers are transported to a winter village, where larger-than-life snowflakes hang from the ceiling and a 35-ft. Christmas tree shines with its silver and icy blue trimmings of snowmen, snowflakes, candles and reindeers. At the bottom of the towering tree, shoppers will be delighted to see three more golden Christmas trees spinning along with the music.

Over at Robinsons Place Manila, shoppers will be treated to a mystical garden tour – with huge Christmas balls; giant roses that bloom and rotate on their own; colorful butterflies flapping their wings; and the best part, a 40-ft. crimson floral tree adorned with glowing northern stars and roses with different textures and materials. All these magical décors are beneath the golden shooting stars hanging from the atrium’s ceiling.

In Robinsons Magnolia, everything sparkles with gold! A 42-ft. Filipiniana-inspired golden spangled Christmas tree greets patrons as they enter the mall. The capiz-embellished tree stands beside a life-size snow globe containing more capiz parols and fairy lights. The enchanting decors continue at The Garden where an astonishing golden ball tree made of durable steel shimmers in the night.

“All these beautiful and vibrant holiday attractions are especially created for all our valued customers who continue to see the silver lining in any situation and adversity. May these Christmas decors inspire us to remain hopeful and grateful and remind us of the true meaning of the Season,” said Arlene Magtibay, SVP and General Manager of Robinsons Malls.
Indeed, tuloy na tuloy pa rin ang Pasko at Robinsons Malls.
